desc: Independent departure clearance for Ensigns and higher after completing T1–T4. Accept, start the assignment, then launch in your active craft.
objective: Conduct an independent flight in your active craft. Request a new clearance before each departure.
sitrep: You are cleared for an independent flight after completing training. Accept this assignment, select Start Mission, then use Launch. Remain in the live universe in your active fighter or ship; no mission scene is loaded. Return to a suitable friendly base when ready. Request a fresh clearance for your next departure. This repeatable assignment pays no credits or promotion points.
